title: Rename billingUrl to billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and 3 consuming apps

summary: Renamed billingUrl -> billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its 3 consumers (core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports) in one mono PR (#1). All three apps built locally; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts is inlined at build time so no library publish/version bump needed; platformkit has no references (grep clean) so untouched; no external consumers per st deps (no catalog entry).
